contributions.detail: Two Form A rows, 200.00 + 500.00 = EXACTLY 700.00 = cover line 1, printed identically in the THIS and CUMULATIVE columns. This is the textbook sub-$50 case: line 2 carries a separate 125.00 aggregate of $50-or-less contributions which the filer did NOT itemise, exactly as the statutory form intends - scoring the two rows against line1+line2 (825.00) would manufacture a false mismatch. The LAST-REPORT cell is the filer's own correction: he first wrote 700.00 there, struck it through, and drew a large 0 over the strike, so the cell resolves to 0 and 0 + 700 = 700 closes the cover's own LAST + THIS = CUMULATIVE identity. LAST = 0 means this is the first report of the cycle, so the two scopes coincide.

expenditures.detail: Two Form B rows, 1128.00 + 111.00 = EXACTLY 1239.00 = cover line 3, printed identically in the THIS and CUMULATIVE columns with a written 0 in the LAST column. First report of the cycle, so the two scopes coincide.
